INSERT INTO telemetry_events
             (organization_id, integration_id, occurred_at, status, duration_ms)
           SELECT $1, $2,
                  now() - make_interval(secs => g * 0.001),
                  CASE WHEN g < $3 THEN 'FAILURE' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END,
                  50
           FROM generate_series(0, $4 - 1) AS g
